detours.why: Boyd and Sasnett Halls have their mapped entrances on their east sides while Terrell Dining Hall and the College of Education stand to their north-west with doors facing west and north, so these short walks go out the east door and round the far side of the hall.
Sasnett Hall's mapped entrance is on its east side and STEM Building A's mapped door is on its east side too, so the walk goes out past Boyd Hall and comes round the complex to the door.

South Donahue Hall's mapped entrance is on Donahue Drive at its north end and no mapped path crosses the parking deck and lots east of it, so the walk goes up Donahue Drive and back down through the Hill halls to the STEM complex.
